concurrency_and_state: CrackBallScr.startAutoCrackBall() spawns a background Thread (AutoCrackBall) that mutates UI/game state (indexSkillSelect, listBall[].yTo, step, timeKame, Char.myCharz().setSkillPaint, SoundMn, Service.gI().SendCrackBall) concurrently with the Unity main thread update()/paint() without locks.
CrackBallScr.AutoCrackBall() calls Thread.ResetAbort() (line 819) and checks isCallStop/isAutoCrackBall without volatile or synchronization.

DataInputStream uses static shared state (istemp, status, filenametemp) with a Thread.Sleep(5) polling loop in _getResourceAsStream() without volatile/locks, though getResourceAsStream() bypasses it and calls __getResourceAsStream() directly.
ClanImage holds unbounded static collections (vClanImage, idImages) and Char.paintCharBody() inserts placeholder new ClanImage() entries keyed by bag ID on the fly.
cross_module_questions: In Service.cs / Server Controller: what opcode and validation does Service.SendCrackBall(type, amount) use, and does the server enforce ticket/gold/gem balance and anti-replay when CrackBallScr.AutoCrackBall sends requests from a background thread?
In GameScr.cs / Char.cs (earlier lines): how are CharInfo[], Arr_Head_2Fr[][], and cHP/cHPFull initialized and synchronized so paintCharBody and paintHp remain consistent?
Does Service.createChar() validate character name length/characters server-side beyond CreateCharScr's 5-10 char check?

findings.impact: Race conditions, torn state updates (step, listBall, indexSkillSelect), and off-main-thread calls to Char/SoundMn/GameScr APIs during auto-crack-ball.
findings.root_cause: startAutoCrackBall() runs AutoCrackBall() on a background Thread that directly mutates CrackBallScr fields, calls doClickBall/useSkillCrackBall, invokes SoundMn and Char.myCharz().setSkillPaint, and calls Thread.ResetAbort() (line 819) without locking or main-thread marshaling.
findings.title: Background thread in CrackBallScr.AutoCrackBall mutates game/UI state without synchronization

findings.impact: Once tickets run out in bag, CrackBallScr continues believing the player has numTicket tickets, miscalculating cost and allowing spin attempts with insufficient currency.
findings.root_cause: checkNumTicket() scans Char.myCharz().arrItemBag for idTicket and sets numTicket only if found, without resetting numTicket = 0 at the start of the method.
findings.title: CrackBallScr.checkNumTicket never resets numTicket to 0 when tickets are exhausted

findings.impact: Unintended double-draw of character head sprite when statusMe == 14 (Dead), and unreachable frame check in stealth paint.
findings.root_cause: In paintCharBody() when statusMe == 14, ph.pi[CharInfo[cf][0][0]] is drawn at lines 6657-6660 and drawn a second time at lines 6674-6680 when !isHead_2Fr(head). In paintCharWithoutSkill() line 6378, GameCanvas.gameTick % 50 == 90 can never be true.
findings.title: Double head rendering when dead and unreachable modulo check in Char.cs

findings.impact: Potential NullReferenceException when calling startChat before initChatTextField, or when cancelling chat with null parentScreen.
findings.root_cause: startChat() accesses right.caption (lines 166, 186) even though right is only created in initChatTextField() (not in the constructor). perform(8001) invokes parentScreen.onCancelChat() without checking parentScreen != null.
findings.title: ChatTextField missing null guards for right command and parentScreen

findings.impact: NullReferenceException if ChooseCharScr.update() runs before updateChooseCharacter(), or ArgumentOutOfRange/NRE in perform(1) if playerData is empty/null.
findings.root_cause: update() iterates vc_players.Length without a null check (unlike paint() at line 85), and perform(1) indexes playerData[focus] checking only focus != -1 without checking playerData != null or bounds.
findings.title: ChooseCharScr missing null/bounds checks on vc_players and playerData

findings.impact: Per-frame heap allocations inside paint() and update() loops cause GC pressure on mobile/Unity client.
findings.root_cause: String concatenations (bag + string.Empty, strEffAura + idAuraEff + "_0", xuStr + string.Empty, " -" + cost, strChat + to, power_point + " " + ...) and array allocations (new int[4] in searchItem/searchFocus) execute directly inside paint() and periodic update() calls.
findings.title: Per-frame string concatenations and array allocations in paint/searchFocus loops

findings.impact: Leaked DataInputStream / myReader instances during character creation map loading, and silent exception swallowing masks failures.
findings.root_cause: loadMapFromResource() and loadMapTableFromResource() open DataInputStream via MyStream.readFile() in loops without calling close(). Multiple paint/update methods use empty catch (Exception) blocks.
findings.title: Unclosed DataInputStream in CreateCharScr and empty catch blocks

findings.impact: Unnecessary map reloads when selecting hair style, and dead/redundant check in CreateCharScr.
findings.root_cause: updateKey() compares num5 != selected (indexHair != 2) instead of num5 != indexHair and triggers doChangeMap(). doChangeMap() assigns TileMap.tileID twice (line 255 overwritten by line 258). Constructor checks tAddName.getText().Equals("@") right after new TField() and calls IndexOf("@") without -1 guard.
findings.title: CreateCharScr hair selection comparison bug and redundant TileMap.tileID assignment

findings.impact: Broken or misleading helper/stub behavior in Char, CharChild, and DartInfo.
findings.root_cause: Char.getcharInjure subtracts HP twice for cHPShow; findNextFocusByKey (PK mode) omits mob.Equals(mobFocus); checkLuong returns int (overflow risk); setDanhHieu overwrites its parameters (smallDanhHieu=0, frame=1) and omits null check on mainImg; CharChild.paintCharBody ignores computed anchor and passes 0; DartInfo.clone() returns null.
findings.title: Logic inconsistencies in Char, CharChild, and DartInfo

module_summary: Deep-read of Client Game1 entity rendering/combat tail (Char.cs lines 5854-8754, CharChild.cs), UI screens (ChatTextField, ChooseCharScr, CrackBallScr, CreateCharScr), Clan/Dart data models, stream wrappers (DataInputStream, DataOutputStream), Cout logger, and GameEnums/GameKeys/PanelConstants. Key risks center on un-synchronized multithreading in CrackBallScr.AutoCrackBall, stale ticket state in CrackBallScr.checkNumTicket, per-frame string/array GC allocations inside paint()/searchFocus(), unclosed streams in CreateCharScr, and missing null checks in UI screens.
